body:

- Four monuments (two on each side)
- Lots of TNT
- No void-building in certain areas
- Height limit of 32 blocks above map surface
- Free dispenser on each kill

replies.author: Hacktivism
replies.body:
I agree that people would be able to make pretty OP defenses easily, but you could also kill the defenders easily by bridging over and dropping down TNT. Also, there are a few blocks of obsidian directly under the monument, so to build an effective defense, those might have to be removed by hand.

I would make it so that a dispenser is rewarded every two kills, but sadly I don't think it's possible to do in the YML. Maybe I'll think of some other way to reward dispensers, for example, if you enter a scorebox on the enemy team or something.

And yes, in some parts of the map, the TNT wouldn't be able to do any damage to blocks.
